import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class BigInteger128 {
        private final long lo;
        private final long hi;

        public BigInteger128(long lo, long hi) {
            this.lo = lo;
            this.hi = hi;
        }

        public static BigInteger128 fromLong(long val) {
            return new BigInteger128(val, val < 0 ? -1L : 0L);
        }

        public BigInteger128 multiply(long val) {
            long lo1 = this.lo;
            long hi1 = this.hi;
            
            long lo_lo = (lo1 & 0xFFFFFFFFL) * (val & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
            long lo_hi = (lo1 & 0xFFFFFFFFL) * (val >>> 32);
            long hi_lo = (lo1 >>> 32) * (val & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
            long hi_hi = (lo1 >>> 32) * (val >>> 32);
            
            long mid = (lo_lo >>> 32) + (lo_hi & 0xFFFFFFFFL) + (hi_lo & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
            long hi_result = hi_hi + (lo_hi >>> 32) + (hi_lo >>> 32) + (mid >>> 32);
            long lo_result = lo_lo & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFL;
            
            return new BigInteger128(lo_result, hi_result);
        }

        public BigInteger128 add(BigInteger128 other) {
            long lo_sum = this.lo + other.lo;
            long hi_sum = this.hi + other.hi + ((lo_sum < this.lo) ? 1L : 0L);
            return new BigInteger128(lo_sum, hi_sum);
        }

        public BigInteger128 subtract(BigInteger128 other) {
            long lo_diff = this.lo - other.lo;
            long hi_diff = this.hi - other.hi - ((lo_diff > this.lo) ? 1L : 0L);
            return new BigInteger128(lo_diff, hi_diff);
        }

        public int compareTo(BigInteger128 other) {
            if (this.hi < other.hi) return -1;
            if (this.hi > other.hi) return 1;
            if (this.lo < other.lo) return -1;
            if (this.lo > other.lo) return 1;
            return 0;
        }

        public boolean lessThanOrEqual(BigInteger128 other) {
            return compareTo(other) <= 0;
        }

        public boolean lessThan(BigInteger128 other) {
            return compareTo(other) < 0;
        }
    }

    static BigInteger128 gcd(BigInteger128 a, BigInteger128 b) {
        while (!b.equals(BigInteger128.fromLong(0))) {
            BigInteger128 temp = a;
            a = b;
            b = temp.subtract(multiplyByLong(a, 1).divide(b));
        }
        return a;
    }

    static BigInteger128 multiplyByLong(BigInteger128 num, long val) {
        return num.multiply(val);
    }

    static BigInteger128 divide(BigInteger128 a, BigInteger128 b) {
        if (b.equals(BigInteger128.fromLong(0))) {
            throw new ArithmeticException("Division by zero");
        }
        
        boolean negative = (a.hi < 0) ^ (b.hi < 0);
        BigInteger128 absA = a.hi < 0 ? a.subtract(a).subtract(a) : a;
        BigInteger128 absB = b.hi < 0 ? b.subtract(b).subtract(b) : b;
        
        BigInteger128 quotient = BigInteger128.fromLong(0);
        BigInteger128 remainder = BigInteger128.fromLong(0);
        
        for (int i = 127; i >= 0; i--) {
            remainder = remainder.multiply(2);
            if ((i < 64 && (absA.lo & (1L << i)) != 0) || (i >= 64 && (absA.hi & (1L << (i - 64))) != 0)) {
                remainder = remainder.add(BigInteger128.fromLong(1));
            }
            
            if (remainder.compareTo(absB) >= 0) {
                remainder = remainder.subtract(absB);
                quotient = quotient.add(BigInteger128.fromLong(1L << i));
            }
        }
        
        if (negative && !quotient.equals(BigInteger128.fromLong(0))) {
            quotient = quotient.subtract(quotient).subtract(quotient);
        }
        
        return quotient;
    }

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long x = Long.parseLong(input[0]);
        long y = Long.parseLong(input[1]);
        long n = Long.parseLong(input[2]);

        long best_num = 0;
        long best_den = 1;
        double min_err = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

        for (long d = 1; d <= n; ++d) {
            long num1 = 0;
            long lo = 0, hi = 100000;
            while (lo <= hi) {
                long mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
                if (multiplySigned(mid, y) <= multiplySigned(x, d)) {

            lo = 0;
            hi = 100000;
            while (lo <= hi) {
                long mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
                if (multiplySigned(mid, y) < multiplySigned(x, d)) {

                }

            double err1 = Math.abs((double) num1 / d - (double) x / y);
            double err2 = Math.abs((double) num2 / d - (double) x / y);

            long chosen_num = num1;

            double chosen_err = err1;

            if (err2 < err1 - 1e-15) {

                chosen_den = d;

            }

            long g = gcd(chosen_num, chosen_den);
            chosen_num /= g;
            chosen_den /= g;

            if (chosen_err < min_err) {
                best_num = chosen_num;
                best_den = chosen_den;
                min_err = chosen_err;
            }

        System.out.println(best_num + "/" + best_den);
    }

    static long multiplySigned(long a, long b) {
